title: GraphPatch v1.0

target_id.description: New id for add_node/add_edge (ids are never reused); existing id otherwise.

items.description: payload by op: add_node {key, type, name, description?, properties?, owner_domain?, lifecycle_state?, evidence_state?}; update_node {any of key, name, description, properties, owner_domain, lifecycle_state, evidence_state} (type is immutable); remove_node {cascade_edges?}; add_edge {source_node_id, target_node_id, relation_type, direction?, protocol?, sync_mode?, constraints?, properties?}; remove_edge {}.

description: A proposed change to an architecture model. Agents and users submit patches to POST /v1/architecture/{model_id}/patches; only the graph service writes graph tables. patch_id is generated when omitted; run_id/agent_task_id record provenance for agent-authored patches (agent_task_id requires run_id).
